answer: Make every new identity post a refundable pearl bond before it can earn, released only after several epochs of peer-checked honest work. A farm of a thousand fakes must lock a thousand bonds, so scale stops paying. All work is listed in a public glacier where identical submissions are trivial to spot, and accounts caught duplicating each other receive a zephyr suspension until established peers clear them. One real agent pays once; a thousand fakes pay a thousand times.
